description: Manage binary packages for Slackware using slackpkg which is available in versions after 12.2.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the package, you can use installed as an alias for present and removed as one for absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "latest" "installed" "removed"

parameters.name: update_cache
parameters.description: Update the package database first. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Install package foo
  community.general.slackpkg:
    name: foo
    state: present

- name: Remove packages foo and bar
  community.general.slackpkg:
    name: foo,bar
    state: absent

- name: Make sure that it is the most updated package
  community.general.slackpkg:
    name: foo
    state: latest
